# Legacy Report Catalog

A compact catalogue of legacy reports useful for product discovery. Use this to map business questions to dashboard opportunities (examples only):
- Curva ABC de Clientes → Top customers / revenue concentration
- Relação de Clientes Inativos → Inactive customers / churn signals
- Pedidos Aguardando Separação de Estoque → Order pipeline / fulfillment bottlenecks

When proposing features, reference the originating legacy report and required data.
